resources.string: Pixel Duo

Pixel Duo uses your hinge sensor and a touch-through overlay to animate folding. A temporary screen image provides the glass effect. Images stay in memory, are discarded after the transition, and are never saved or sent. The service does not read text, perform gestures, or change your wallpaper.
A little motion.\nEvery fold.
A smooth glass animation that follows your Pixel’s hinge.

One quick setup

Allow Pixel Duo in Android’s accessibility settings to show the animation above your apps. A temporary screen image creates the glass effect. It stays on your phone and is discarded after the transition.\n\nSelect Pixel Duo, then turn on Use Pixel Duo. Return here when you’re done.
If Android blocks the switch, open Settings → Apps → Pixel Duo → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then return.
